title: Application of the antitussive agents oxelaidin and butamirate as anti-glioma agents.
authors: Lee, Sook-Ja; Yeom, Seon-Yong; Lee, Jee-Young; Park, Chaehwa
one_liner_zh: 该文研究止咳药oxelaidin和butamirate通过抑制STAT3转录活性抗胶质母细胞瘤，仅涉及药物与RRAD蛋白的对接模拟，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或MD方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Glioblastoma (GBM) is an aggressive brain tumor with a strong tendency of relapse and resistance to chemotherapy, but we currently lack non-toxic agents that effectively treat GBM. In this study, high-throughput screening of FDA-approved drugs was performed to identify safe and effective molecules and test their effect on GBM cell lines, LN229, U87 and T98G. Cough suppressants, oxelaidin and butamirate inhibited GBM growth. A Ras family GTPase, Ras-related associated with diabetes (RRAD), contributes to activation of STAT3, which is essential for survival and growth of many cancer types. Interestingly, oxelaidin and butamirate did not affect proliferation in RRAD negative GBM cells. Docking simulation analyses revealed selective interactions between oxelaidin and RRAD. The mechanism by which butamirate and oxelaidin inhibits GBM cell growth involves the suppression of STAT3 transcriptional activity, leading to down-regulation of cyclin D1 and survivin. In addition, components of RRAD-associated signaling cascades, including p-EGFR, p-Akt, and p-STAT3, were inhibited upon oxelaidin treatment. Intraperitoneal administration of oxelaidin or butamirate markedly suppressed tumor growth in a glioblastoma xenograft mouse model without significant adverse effects. Our collective findings indicate that oxelaidin and butamirate exert anti-tumor effects in glioblastoma, supporting its utility as a novel therapeutic candidate for glioblastoma.
abstract_zh: 胶质母细胞瘤（GBM）是一种侵袭性脑肿瘤，具有强烈的复发倾向和对化疗的耐药性，但目前我们缺乏能有效治疗GBM的无毒药物。在本研究中，对FDA批准的药物进行了高通量筛选，以识别安全有效的分子，并测试其对GBM细胞系LN229、U87和T98G的影响。镇咳药奥昔拉定（oxelaidin）和布他米酯（butamirate）抑制了GBM的生长。一种Ras家族GTP酶，即与糖尿病相关的Ras相关蛋白（RRAD），有助于激活STAT3，而STAT3对多种癌症的生存和生长至关重要。有趣的是，奥昔拉定和布他米酯对RRAD阴性的GBM细胞增殖无影响。对接模拟分析揭示了奥昔拉定与RRAD之间的选择性相互作用。布他米酯和奥昔拉定抑制GBM细胞生长的机制涉及抑制STAT3转录活性，导致细胞周期蛋白D1和生存素（survivin）的下调。此外，RRAD相关信号级联组分，包括p-EGFR、p-Akt和p-STAT3，在奥昔拉定处理后受到抑制。在胶质母细胞瘤异种移植小鼠模型中，腹腔注射奥昔拉定或布他米酯显著抑制了肿瘤生长，且无明显不良反应。我们的综合发现表明，奥昔拉定和布他米酯在胶质母细胞瘤中发挥抗肿瘤作用，支持其作为胶质母细胞瘤的新型治疗候选药物的实用性。
